name: Impact of Knowledge
main_effect: [Main] Suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon. Then, if you have a Tamer with [Izzy Izumi] in its name, until the end of your opponent's turn, 1 of your opponent's Digimon gains "[On Deletion] Trash the top card of your security stack."
source_effect: Security Effect [Security] Suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon. Then, add this card to the hand.
